pairs.subject: stream-proxy-hop
pairs.evidence: app/api/workspace/export/route.ts:60 Every route in this context (auth login/logout/register/switch-workspace, workspace export/import, workspaces CRUD, ops, health) answers a single buffered JSON response and never opens a long-lived outbound read to re-emit downstream, so the subject's precondition does not hold; a search of the context directories and the app/api contract tests for text/event-stream, EventSource, getReader and pipeTo found nothing (zero hits across all of app/api too), and every 'proxy' hit means the Next proxy.ts auth gate, not a stream hop.

techniques.evidence: app/api/workspace/export/route.ts:62 The export is a one-shot JSON attachment, not an event stream, so there is no idle path to keep warm.
app/api/workspace/export/route.ts:60 The response is fully buffered, so no stream reaches a lifetime cap.
